name: Ashley Nicole Leal
title: Computer Engineering Student @ University of Toronto; Software Engineer Intern @ Qualcomm
bio:
Ashley Nicole Leal is a Computer Engineering student at the University of Toronto, pursuing minors in AI and Business and specializing in software development. She is currently completing a PEY internship at Qualcomm, working on low-power AI software and machine learning.

Ashley has held leadership roles at the IEEE University of Toronto Student Branch for nearly three years, serving as Branch Chair and Technical Team Director, leading initiatives to engage students in technology and professional development. She also currently serves as a Student Campus Ambassador for Edge Impulse.

Her experience spans diverse areas, including game development, web development, blockchain, and embedded systems, and she enjoys exploring new tech and building cool projects that mix creativity with impact.
